messages:
Samir Patel (CS Lead): kicking off Aurelia Health onboarding thread. want to capture stakeholders, success metrics, timeline, and any obvious renewal/legal risks. propose 20m sync today at 3pm PT.
Olivia Park (AE): booked 3pm. note from sales: Aurelia requested HIPAA BA amendment language; legal needs ~7 business days to review. potential renewal impact if contract stalls. :hourglass:
Dr. Mei Chen (Clinical Dir): adding clinical goals: reduce chart lookup time for nurses by 30% and validate alert accuracy with three pilot users. happy to join calls.
Jordan Lee (Integration Eng): tech checklist: need SFTP endpoint for batch exports, FHIR API access, and sandbox patient data (de-identified). estimate 3 dev days post-creds.
Priya Rao (Legal): noted BA amendment. please share customer's suggested redlines. I can fast-track with a 48h SLA if procurement confirms PO is on track.
Samir Patel (CS Lead): proposed success criteria (assign owners):
- BA amendment executed and PO signed (owner: Olivia)
- EHR batch exports validated to Redwood ingest (owner: Jordan)
- 3 nurse users complete triage workflow w/ >=90% satisfaction (owner: Dr. Chen)
- No P0 incidents in pilot window (owner: Samir)
Olivia Park (AE): I
'll own procurement and can chase finance. if PO delayed >10bd, we switch to limited synthetic-data pilot to keep timeline.
Jordan Lee (Integration Eng): question on creds: do we do SSO or API key for initial ingest? SSO adds overhead. prefer API key/service account for sandbox.
Dr. Mei Chen (Clinical Dir): service account is fine for dev. will escalate internally if there are data governance concerns.
Enablement-Bot: placeholder: enablement session templates available: https://intra.example.com/enablement/templates
Samir Patel (CS Lead): timeline draft:
```
Week0: Kickoff + legal/PO check
Week1: Sandbox creds + basic EHR export validation
Week2: Clinician pilot (3 users) + enablement admin session
Week3: Ops workshop + feedback collection
Week4: Pilot review + contract finalization / go/no-go
```
If BA amendment extends beyond 2w, pivot to synthetic-data pilot (scope: UI + workflow only).
Olivia Park (AE): I'll upload the customer's redline doc and timeline for legal review by EOD.
Priya Rao (Legal): once redlines are in, I'll triage with our counsel. flagging potential data residency clause that may need exec approval.
Samir Patel (CS Lead): enablement plan: Jordan + Enablement to run 45m admin + 60m hands-on for nurses. Maya from enablement can you join? (Maya not in thread yet)
Jordan Lee (Integration Eng): action items recap: Olivia -> procurement/redlines; Jordan -> sandbox & validation script; Dr. Chen -> clinician slots & feedback questions; Priya -> legal review; Samir -> SLOs and incident playbook.
Dr. Mei Chen (Clinical Dir): will provide feedback form questions; prefer short Likert items + one free-text.
Olivia Park (AE): will escalate PO if no signature in 8 business days. planning exec ping on day 9 if needed.
Samir Patel (CS Lead): great. drop any blockers here before the sync at 3pm. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
